 Judgment
The claimant in LAC No.447/2010 on the file of Senior Civil Judge, Athani is before this Court seeking enhancement of compensation.
2. The land belonging to the petitioner bearing Sy.No.490 measuring 1 acre 23 guntas in Satti village, Taluk Athani was acquired for Hipparagi project.
Section 4(1) notification was issued on 19.04.2007.
The Special Land Acquisition Officer has awarded Rs.1,18,656/- per acre as the compensation.
The Reference Court enhanced the compensation to Rs.2,02,650/- per acre.
In this appeal, the appellant is claiming Rs.5,00,000/- per acre as compensation.

3. Learned counsel for the appellant would place reliance on the judgment of Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in MFA No.101402/2016 disposed of on 17.04.2021 and would submit that for the land situated in Satti village, Athani Taluk this Court has awarded compensation of Rs.5,00,000/- per acre.
It is also his contention that in the NC: 2023:KHC-D:10269 said case the land was acquired in terms of the notification of the year 2007.

In the said order, the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court also referred to the affidavit filed by the beneficiary where the beneficiary has agreed to pay compensation of Rs.5,00,000/- per acre in respect of the lands acquired for the notification of the year 2004 for Hipparagi project.

4. Sri.Umesh Ainapur, the learned counsel for the respondent - beneficiary does not dispute the fact that the beneficiary has filed an affidavit in the earlier proceedings stating that the beneficiary is paying Rs.5,00,000/- per acre as compensation for the lands situated in Satti village, Taluk Athani which were acquired for Hipparagi project.
5. He also does not dispute that the lands acquired in this case are similar to the lands acquired in MFA No.101402/2016.
This Court has considered the contentions raised at the bar.

7. Since the land involved in this case was acquired in the year 2007 for the same project and it is from the same village, this Court is of the view that the appellant has made out a case for Shri Nemanna Ningappa Dadappagol vs The Special Land Acquisition Officer on 8 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67313291/
2 enhancement of compensation, as awarded in MFA No.101402/2016.
8.

sentences.text: This being the position, the impugned judgment and award passed by the Reference Court in LAC No.447/2010 on the file of Senior Civil Judge, Athani dated 28.03.2011 are modified and compensation of Rs.5,00,000/- per acre is awarded along with statutory benefits.
The appellant is also entitled to proportionate cost.

9. It is also relevant to note that this Court vide order dated 07.09.2023 has condoned the delay subject to condition that in case the compensation is enhanced the appellant is not entitled to interest for 3348 days on the NC: 2023:KHC-D:10269 enhanced compensation.
Accordingly, the appellant is not entitled to interest for 3348 days on the enhanced compensation.
10. In view of the above, the appeal is allowed in part.
